description: Full BLE advertising-data assembly and parsing, both carriers. Carrier A cases MUST encode and decode. Carrier B cases carry no frame on air and MUST report carrier=GATT_PULL so the scanner knows to connect.

service_uuid.status: PROVISIONAL — NOT SIG-ALLOCATED — MUST NOT SHIP. See SPEC.md §4.1.

budget.note: Carrier A leaves 1 spare byte. The 7 bytes between the 19-byte frame and the 26 B ceiling in CLAUDE.md are AD-header margin and are not spendable (SPEC.md §5.1).

structures.name: Flags
structures.note: LE General Discoverable | BR/EDR Not Supported

cases.name: carrier-b-uuid-only
cases.note: An iOS peripheral. No frame on air. The scanner must connect and read beacon_payload.

cases.name: carrier-b-uuid-only-no-flags-ad
cases.note: Some stacks emit the Flags AD themselves and it may not appear in what the app receives. Absence of the Flags structure MUST NOT cause rejection.

cases.name: foreign-service-data-ignored
cases.note: Service data for a different 16-bit UUID (0xFD6F). MUST be ignored entirely, not parsed as ours.

cases.name: our-uuid-with-truncated-service-data
cases.note: Service data present for our UUID but only 4 payload bytes. Malformed, not a GATT_PULL peer.

cases.name: ad-length-overruns-buffer
cases.note: AD structure claims a length that runs past the end of the buffer. Classic parser overrun. MUST be rejected without reading out of bounds.

cases.name: ad-zero-length-structure
cases.note: A zero length byte must terminate parsing, not loop forever.

cases.name: duplicate-service-data-for-our-uuid
cases.note: Two Service Data structures for our UUID. Ambiguous and not something a conformant peripheral emits. Reject rather than pick one.
